SimpleMessageLib (V300) is absent from Pillar's generated sandbox table; upstream has no V300 hash builder either (both refuse). Accounted test gap.

Upstream getUlnVersionFromAddress also maps ReceiveUln302 to V302 for an EndpointV2 PacketSent; Pillar accepts only SendUln302 (and ReadLib1002 for ReadV1002). Pillar is stricter; an EndpointV2 PacketSent naming a receive library is not expected on chain [INFERENCE]. Accepted divergence.
V2-only EVM chains: Pillar runtime config requires EndpointV2/SendUln302/ReceiveUln302 and refuses them; upstream signs ULNv2. Open implementation gap.
Aptos legacy ULNv2 source account (packet_event::OutboundEvent) has no Pillar binding. Open gap, blocked on archival fixture.
Upstream also trusts the Aptos V1 ULN301 module for initia/movement V301 sends; those chains have no EndpointV1 eid, so Pillar trusts only EndpointV2. Pillar stricter.
